This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 3, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say. Al-Mughayyir's council says they were trying to stop settlers stealing sheep, but the Israeli military says they threw stones at its troops. This was reported by BBC News.

2. No end to torture of Gaza doctor Abu Safia in Israeli prison: What to know. Abu Safia, who has been under custody for nearly two years, continues to face abuse inside prison, his lawyer says. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the September 3, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
